name: Futanari Resort
source: Futanari Resort is a visual novel set on an exclusive, secluded island resort known for its breathtaking scenery and unusual cultural traditions centered around futanari identity. You play as a young man, totally ignorant to the idea of a futanari and the island’s history, who is invited to the island for a summer vaction by a long-unseen childhood friend. Not long after you arrive you recieve an unorthodox welcome and the fact that this vacation will not be normal becomes evident.  This futanari adventure quickly turns into something deeper as you meet the diverse guests and staff, each hiding personal struggles, ambitions, and secrets tied to the island.
